metadata.case_name: LIU CHEN v. CHAN POON WING AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: Deputy Chief of the Foreign Investment Trade and Economic Co-operation Bureau of Huangshi City, Hubei Province
plaintiff.occupation_after: Deputy Manager of Huangshi City Economic Office

injuries.description: liver laceration and splenic laceration extending to parenchyma requiring laparotomy of which splenectomy and plication of bleeding liver laceration were performed
source: (a) liver laceration and splenic laceration extending to parenchyma requiring laparotomy of which splenectomy and plication of bleeding liver laceration were performed,

injuries.description: severe head injury with Glascow coma score 5 and subarachnoid haemorrhage treated conservatively
source: (c) severe head injury with Glascow coma score 5 and subarachnoid haemorrhage treated conservatively,

injuries.description: multiple rib fractures (right 4th to 6th ribs and left 4th to 7th ribs) with right pneumothorax requiring insertion of chest drain
source: (b) multiple rib fractures (right 4th to 6th ribs and left 4th to 7th ribs) with right pneumothorax requiring insertion of chest drain,

injuries.description: sprained left knee with tear at body of lateral meniscus
source: Dr Lam believed (and I accept) the Plaintiff had a sprained left knee with tear at body of lateral meniscus (which could explain the residual knee pain at the lateral side of left knee).
injuries.icd_description: Injury to multiple structures of knee

injuries.description: right knee injury, ie posterior cruciate ligament ("PCL") injury
source: (d) right knee injury, ie posterior cruciate ligament (“PCL”) injury,
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of posterior cruciate ligament of knee, excluding rupture

injuries.description: reduced visual acuity of 20/40 on the Snellen chart for both eyes and constricted peripheral vision for the left eye
source: reduced visual acuity of 20/40 on the Snellen chart for both eyes and constricted peripheral vision for the left eye.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of eye or orbit, unspecified

injuries.description: 雙側感音神經性耳聾（右側重度，左側輕度）
source: 雙側感音神經性耳聾（右側重度，左側輕度）
injuries.icd_description: Injury of middle or inner ear

injuries.description: laparotomy and release of intestinal obstruction due to adhesion done on 22 March 2004 during the 2nd PRC Hospital Stay
source: the laparotomy and release of intestinal obstruction due to adhesion done on 22 March 2004 during the 2nd PRC Hospital Stay
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injury of small intestine

injuries.description: open wound of the face and scalp laceration with suturing performed; healed mid-line laparotomy scar (22-25cm) and facial/scalp scars
source: (e) open wound of the face and scalp laceration with suturing performed.
healed 25cm (the Chan Report) or 22cm (the Lam Report) mid-line laparotomy scar
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of head

manifestations.description: post-concussional syndrome (residual headache, non-specific dizziness, irritability and subjectively-impaired memory)
impaired memory (forgetfulness requiring writing things down)
reduced visual acuity and constricted peripheral vision
mild residual chest pain, on and off aching upon exertion
frequent bowel opening / diarrhoea (change of bowel habit)

treatments_received: laparotomy with splenectomy and plication of bleeding liver laceration
sutures to face and scalp lacerations
laparotomy and release of intestinal obstruction due to adhesion (22 March 2004)
treatments_future: arthroscopic meniscectomy of left knee (recommended by Dr Lam)
medication for symptomatic relief for post-concussional syndrome
medical treatment/nutritional therapy for hearing disturbance (as recommended)

losses.description: loss of spleen and laceration injury to the liver requiring splenectomy and plication of liver laceration
mild visual disturbance (reduced visual acuity and constricted peripheral vision)
mild hearing disturbance / sensorineural hearing loss
